Responsibilities - Design, build, and visually dress engaging levels and mini-games from concept to final polish using internal tools and Unity. - Plan level progression and craft difficulty curves that keep players engaged, using quantitative player data, A/B test results, and user feedback to continuously test, tweak, and balance the experience. - Guide and collaborate with Art, Animation, and Tech Art teams, providing clear feedback to ensure all visual assets are perfectly tailored for your level designs. - Take full ownership of driving levels to production, motivating and leading cross-functional teams to meet strict deadlines and run schedules. - Actively pitch and contribute ideas for new game mechanics, obstacles, and themes to keep the gameplay varied and fresh. - Apply strong game design and UX principles to guarantee optimal layout, and overall player satisfaction. - Continuously improve your level creation pipeline, exploring new tools (including AI-driven workflows) to work smarter and scale production. Requirements - Proven experience in the gaming industry in hands-on or creative roles (such as Level Designer, Game Designer, Tech Artist, or Product Manager). - Basic working knowledge of Unity or any other game engine (no need to be an expert), and a strong ability to quickly master internal proprietary level editors. - Strong project management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and guide Art, Tech Art, and Operations teams to deliver on time. - A keen eye for composition, aesthetics, and visual storytelling, coupled with a strong product design mindset. - Proven experience in continuous, data-driven level balancing (using metrics and A/B testing to refine difficulty and player flow). - A creative, proactive, and ownership-driven ("can-do") approach to overcoming design challenges and production bottlenecks. - Deep love for gaming - especially casual mobile games - with a constant drive to engineer new and exciting player experiences. Advantage - Familiarity with Generative AI tools for level ideation or content generation workflows. - A portfolio showcasing engaging, visually polished levels or relevant gameplay projects.
